title: LATAM Airlines Group Announces the Publication of its 2025 Annual Integrated Report
summary: - LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (LATAM Airlines Group or the "Company) (NYSE: LTM / SSE: LTM) and its affiliates, the leading airline group in South America, announces the publication of its 2025 Annual Integrated Report in English and Spanish. The 2025 Annual Integrated Report highlights LATAM groups key milestones throughout the year, including solid financial performance, the continued execution of its profitable growth strategy and initiatives aimed at enhancing both the customer and employee experience, alongside progress in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) dimensions. It captures how the group is advancing with purpose, creating opportunities and value for its customers, employees, and the environment. The document in Spanish is available on the website of the Financial Market Commission at www.cmfchile.cl or on the Companys Investor Relations website at ir.latam.com in both languages.
